attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Strength or Melee skill + 1d6+3; you may additionally discard this card to add another 1d6+3. 

If you play an ally that has the Animal trait on this check, you may reveal the ally instead of recharging, discarding, or burying it.
